directories.note: Staff portraits delivered by the founder. VISUALLY VERIFIED 2026-11-25: ellis-dennis-graham.jpg is an authentic studio portrait, not AI-generated. The founder confirmed the homepage imagery is likewise his own.

Photographs of the classroom at 24 Ebony Road. VISUALLY VERIFIED 2026-11-25: lab-1.jpg shows real learners, real HP/Dell hardware, a genuine whiteboard with handwriting and a wall-mounted TV. These are the Academy's own photographs and are the strongest asset on the site — they are what separates this property from every AI-illustrated competitor.

AI-GENERATED, stated by the site owner on 2026-11-25. These appear on the homepage as course covers and in academy/media.ts. AdSense treats undisclosed synthetic imagery as a misrepresentation risk when it implies a real facility or outcome, so every use must be caption or alt-text honest: depict the subject, never imply it is CEA's campus, staff or learners.
